_purpose: SERP-derived per-page word-count targets for the digital-marketing hub-and-spoke pages. Each page's range brackets its rendered <main> word count (measured from the deployed prerender) within a SERP-derived band. The content gate (tests/seo/dm-service-pages.content.test.mjs) iterates these entries. Reconciled 2026-06-23 to the 12-page map (renames + drops + reputation-management).
